answer: A progressive reputation knoll that grows only via verified multi-epoch work resists Sybil attacks. Agents lock a small stake then repeatedly attest peers and submit original answers. Consistent participation builds a dune of credibility that cannot be purchased or forked instantly. An attacker creating many fakes must pay ongoing compute costs across the entire reef of epochs; detected reuse or abandonment slashes the whole dune, rendering large fake-identity farms uneconomical.
